contents.name: §7.A, Proposition 7.A.1, printed pp.213–214, and Proposition 7.A.3, printed p.215: ICC factor criterion and faithful normal regular trace
contents.reason: The restored verification proves separate-WOT tracial extension, right-regular faithfulness, scalar centre, and exclusion of type I locally. These exact source passages replace the incorrect §7.D assignment.

contents.name: Proposition 6.B.14, printed pp.186–187: type I factor representations are multiples of irreducibles
contents.reason: Actual use is the proved local spatial type-I splitting supplier, followed by the explicit finite-trace contradiction. General central uniqueness and the broader Glimm machinery are not used in this case.

contents.name: Chapter 3: examples of irreducible representations (nilpotent, affine, Baumslag-Solitar, lamplighter)
contents.reason: The examples page only exhibits the two free-factor decompositions and the compact/abelian/ICC models; the broader example catalogue belongs to other pairs of the run.

contents.name: Chapter 1 §1.D, Proposition 1.D.3, printed p. 40: invokes L1(G) separability for second-countable G without proof; the item supplies the countable dense family locally

sources.title: Bruce Blackadar, Operator Algebras: Theory of C*-Algebras and von Neumann Algebras (author-hosted complete text)
sources.locator: Part I §2.5 (commutants and bicommutants, printed pp. 16-17), §I.5.2.1–I.5.2.2 (support projections and polar decomposition, printed pp. 23–24), §9.1 (bicommutant theorem, printed p. 49); Part II §§4-5 (approximate units and density, printed pp. 93-96) and §10 (group C*-algebras and induced representations, printed pp. 212-222); Part III §1.5 (type I factors and matrix units, III.1.5.1-5, printed pp. 247-248 (PDF pp. 255-256)), §1.6 (direct integrals and the central decomposition, printed pp. 252-254, PDF pp. 260-262), §2 (normal functionals, printed pp. 269-300) and §3 (group von Neumann algebras and factors, printed pp. 301-318); Part IV §1.5 (type I C*-algebras and the Glimm equivalences, printed pp. 358-361, read with the explicit omissions recorded in research/frontier-43-complex-representation-15-glimm-source-resolution.md).

contents.name: III.1.5.1–III.1.5.3, printed p.247 (PDF p.255): spatial type I factor splitting; III.1.6.1–III.1.6.4, printed pp.252–254: field and central-diagonal context
contents.reason: The splitting conclusion is supplied by the complete local type-I lemma. The ICC case verifies its one-point central model directly; Blackadar explicitly calls the general direct-integral construction an outline, and no unproved general disintegration result replaces this case proof.

contents.name: III.3.3.1–III.3.3.7, printed pp.306–307 (PDF pp.314–315): regular group algebra, finite trace, ICC examples and factor criterion
contents.reason: These complete passages have been read for this merge proposal. The local ICC verification proves faithfulness, normality, finite trace, scalar centre, infinite dimension, exclusion of type I and both concrete ICC examples; no type-II classification theorem is required.

contents.name: III.1.6.1–III.1.6.2, printed pp.252–253 (PDF pp.260–261): measurable integral and fibrewise operators; counting-measure specialization
contents.reason: Blackadar supplies the field/operator framework, not a separate explicit counting-sum theorem here. The example proves its counting specialization directly, with completed square-summable Hilbert sums, zero inactive fibres and an effective canonical measure supported on occurring classes.

contents.name: Part II §10: induced-representation context originally assigned to the free-group case
contents.reason: This passage is supplementary context, not the source of the monomial criteria used in the completed F2 proof. Exact local transversal, self-commensurator, irreducibility and inequivalence suppliers plus Bekka–de la Harpe Example 1.G.11 and Fourier/GNS prove the complete approved countermodel. No claim is removed and this source remains retained and fully fetched.
